geometry.intrinsics: c.f and optional fy/cx/cy scaled by tw/fw; row-major world-to-camera R,t; RGB already undistorted; quaternion is cached w,x,y,z and local z is surface normal.

cost.caveat: Single Node/V8 CPU run under concurrent software rendering, not phone timing; extrapolations are arithmetic only and omit reusing geometric/reference-patch work.

projectedAnisotropy.cameraDomain: Raw projected covariance at cached320x180 training intrinsics, without raster minimum footprint/filter inflation. Cached tangent scales equal, thickness is sigmaNormal/sigmaTangent0.15.

limitations: Only one cached real capture; no retraining or rendered-quality measurement.
Third training camera is excluded from depth selection and confidence, but the original cached initializer used all views when admitting supported points.
Sparse occlusion guards can reject known foreground conflicts but do not prove visibility in unobserved regions.
Normal is fixed to the original sparse triangle; the sweep can test local depth only, not wrong normals, moving leaves, specular changes, or mismatched camera poses.
